Facetmode: voronoi: object-space 3D cells, each with its own tilted normal. flat: face normals from screen derivatives, which shows the mesh triangles.
Facetscale: Density of the facets (cells per object unit); higher = more, smaller facets.
Facetstrength: How far each facet normal is tilted from the surface normal; 0 = smooth, higher = more fragmented refraction.
Ior: Mean index of refraction of the crystal. 1 = no bending, about 1.55 is quartz-like.
Dispersion: Difference in IOR between the red and blue channels; higher splits colours into rainbow fringes. 0 = none.
Inner: How different the exit facet is from the entry facet (internal fragmentation). 0 = same facet, 1 = very broken-up interior.
Sparkle: Intensity of the glittering internal flakes. 0 = off.
Sparklescale: Density of the internal flakes; higher = more, smaller flakes.
Twinkle: How much the flakes pulse in a looping cycle. 0 = steady, 1 = full twinkle.
Tint: Colour the crystal absorbs light towards (white = clear).
Tintamt: Amount of absorption tint applied. 0 = clear, 1 = full tint.
Absorb: Absorption density; higher makes thick or grazing paths darker and more saturated with Tint.
Reflect: Gain of the surface reflection and facet edge glints. 0 = none.
Speed: Speed of the material and preview animation. 1 = normal, 0 = frozen.
Envmix: Blend between the built-in procedural studio environment (0) and the equirect environment map on in1 (1).
Envrot: Rotates the environment around the vertical axis, 0-1 = one full turn.
Envgain: Brightness multiplier of the environment that is reflected or refracted.
Accent: Strength of the red accent light bar in the procedural environment. 0 = no red bar.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Geometry: Preview shapes: both shows a sphere and a torus knot, sphere or knot shows only that one.
Spin: Number of full preview rotations per animation cycle. 0 = no spin.
Camdist: Preview camera distance from the objects in world units; larger = smaller objects.
Backdrop: Brightness of the preview background. 0 = black.
Exposure: Brightness multiplier applied to the preview render before tonemapping.
Vignette: Darkening of the preview corners. 0 = none, higher = stronger.
